purpose: Small controlled probe for deciding whether the Qwen3-8B layers 0-6 are useful for live-memory CAVs. Held-out examples deliberately reduce keyword overlap with the training examples.

concepts.name: context_dependency
concepts.description: The statement depends on information, decisions, identities, or evidence established earlier rather than being self-contained.

positive: Remember the database choice we made earlier and use it for this migration.
Retrieve the user's preferred timezone from the prior conversation.
This bug is connected to the benchmark result mentioned several turns ago.
Continue the implementation from the checkpoint recorded in our previous session.
Use the API contract that we agreed on before generating the client.
Recall which model produced the earlier baseline and compare against it.
The current request refers back to the filename supplied at the start.
Find the old decision about token limits before packing this context.
Link this correction to the claim it superseded in the conversation history.
Resume the unresolved task from our last exchange.
Apply the naming convention established in the preceding design discussion.
The answer requires the credentials policy that was stated previously.

concepts.name: binding_constraint
concepts.description: A prescriptive requirement, prohibition, limit, or invariant rather than a descriptive observation.

positive: The implementation must preserve source provenance for every memory.
Never place authentication tokens in the repository.
Use Pixi for all project Python commands.
Retrieval may return at most ten chunks.
The response must not exceed the available context budget.
Always validate the resolved path before deleting an artifact.
Only memories belonging to the active user may be retrieved.
The API identifier must remain stable across migrations.
Do not treat an attention weight as causal evidence.
Every compressed summary needs a pointer to its original turns.
The worker is required to finish writes before acknowledging success.
Prefer reversible pruning until the retention policy is validated.
negative: The implementation currently stores provenance beside each memory.
Authentication tokens were found in an environment file.
The project uses Pixi to create its Python environment.
Retrieval returned ten chunks during the benchmark.
The response consumed most of the available context budget.
The resolved path points to a temporary artifact directory.
These memories belong to the active user.
The API identifier remained stable during the last migration.
The attention weight was larger in the final layer.
Each compressed summary contains a source pointer.
The worker finished its writes before sending the acknowledgement.
The current pruning operation moves records into cold storage.

positive: Ship only after the regression suite passes.
Any retrieved claim needs a source pointer.
Keep credentials outside version control.
Limit graph traversal to three hops.
The response should fit within twelve hundred tokens.
Do not merge records from different users.
Prefer existing identifiers when importing data.
The cache directory has to remain disposable.
negative: The regression suite passed before the release shipped.
The retrieved claim includes a source pointer.
Credentials are stored outside version control.
Graph traversal reached three hops in this run.
The response occupied twelve hundred tokens.
The two records came from different users.
The import retained all existing identifiers.
